[LSTO.4.7.2] The engine's cache is authoritative and must be mutated
**only** by `cache` / `cache_delete` on the deterministic input
stream, a TTL expiry ([LSTO.4.6.1]), an `initial` block's cache item
([LGRA.24.3]), and the startup hydrate ([LSTO.4.5.2]). The write-through
hook is outbound only (engine → external store); an out-of-band write
to a cached key — an external writer mutating the store behind the
engine's back — is unsupported. This constraint is load-bearing: it
is what lets `cached()` be a pure internal read that leaves the
recorded-input set ([RARC.5.7.9] / [RFCS.15.7] / [LFST.9.2]).
